options.A: Accepted under protest with damage noted on the receipt

options.A: The supplier is a government firm

q: The main risk of provisional receipt is:

options.A: Shortages or defects surfacing after the claim period has lapsed

options.A: The seals are intact and packages look fine

options.D: Horizontal and vertical distances for labour charges in stacking

options.B: Goods remain on railway land beyond the free period
